Requires the sample photos, the saved pet’s fingerprint and the possible sighting on the watch.

runs.description: The dashboard after a watch on the kitten clip: its new alerts since you last looked, and the four ways to watch.
longDescription: 0–2 seconds. The dashboard shows the four ways to watch after a watch on the kitten clip.
2–4 seconds. The page scrolls to Since you last looked.
4–6 seconds. The new movement and sound alerts remain on screen.

runs.description: A watch starting on the kitten clip: the Motion and Sound meters rise as a dog barks.
longDescription: 0–2 seconds. Start watching opens the camera on a kitten on a grey carpet.
2–6 seconds. The kitten grooms itself and its movement raises the Motion meter.
6–9 seconds. The Sound meter rises over its line as a dog barks off camera.
9–10 seconds. The watch continues on the kitten.

runs.description: Settings say how this device is set: what it watches for and what raises an alert.
longDescription: 0–2 seconds. Settings shows Detection first, then the settings that follow it.
2–5 seconds. The page scrolls through the list of settings.
5–6 seconds. The final settings remain on screen.
